title: Grade 12 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #7

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   C. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.
   B. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   B. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected chapter Surah Yusuf and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Islamic Law and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. A — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

9. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. B — Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Science of Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Administration of Islamic Law; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
